surface.role: Display interpolation of 52 measured system-level similarity statistics; intermediate positions are not new systems or measured dynamical values.

examples.source: Existing eval_records.csv; includes failed evaluation at alpha=0.75.

method.fusion: Content-only, pair-specific CAE; L=(1-alpha)L_A+alpha L_B, with three encoder layers weighted equally.
method.orientation: alpha=0 is system a; alpha=1 is system b. Reverse the path if a user selects the opposite direction.
method.normalization: Attractor box mapped to [0,1]^3; mean vector norm on a 48^3 grid scaled to 5.0.

componentDefinitions.label: Path deviation
componentDefinitions.meaning: How far the fusion spectrum bends away from its linear endpoint reference.
componentDefinitions.finiteConvention: Mean over valid interior evaluations; requires both endpoints.

componentDefinitions.label: Path roughness
componentDefinitions.meaning: Local changes of slope along the spectrum path.
componentDefinitions.finiteConvention: Mean only over consecutive triples of valid evaluations; no interpolation across failed weights.

componentDefinitions.label: Chaos loss
componentDefinitions.meaning: Fraction of the nine evaluations without a positive measured maximal exponent.
componentDefinitions.finiteConvention: Includes the two endpoints. Nonpositive finite-time MLE does not by itself distinguish periodic or equilibrium dynamics.

method.rankNormalization: Percentile ranks across all 1326 unordered pairs, with average ranks for exact ties and denominator 1325. Missing raw components are placed after the largest finite value and share the corresponding worst-end average rank.
method.landscapeInterpretation: Low U denotes a system with high average affinity to the other systems; high U denotes relative isolation under this fusion protocol. U is not physical energy or a dynamical potential governing the systems.
method.embeddingInterpretation: The two coordinates are saved spectral-embedding coordinates, rescaled separately to [-1,1]. They are dimensionless display coordinates; clustering is computed from the full affinity matrix, not from this two-dimensional view.
method.surfaceInterpretation: The continuous surface is a display interpolation using the original plotting script's IDW method, not evidence for unmeasured intermediate systems, physical basins, or transition barriers.
method.failureInterpretation: All saved FAIL records report numerical trajectory explosion or non-finite values. Render them as gaps or failure markers; never substitute zero Lyapunov exponents.

audit.clusterLabelSource: Use the same landscape_scores.csv as the existing classification.json. Other archived k7 order files contain a different partition and are deliberately not mixed into this export.

provenance.paper: Physical Review Research 8, 033337 (2026), Sec. IV, Fig. 4–6, Appendix E/Fig. 20
provenance.numericPolicy: Saved spectra, raw components, ranks, distances, coordinates, cluster labels and point heights are retained. Only the display mesh is newly interpolated, at the requested browser resolution.
